data.body: Implementation validation complete before review push. Held-out canonical/legacy oracle passed after one state-label follow-up; exact mutation reintroduced the wrong canonical gate label and returned RED, then restored GREEN. Full-suite preflight exposed the established string-patched _pause_exit_code seam had been renamed; existing selection/request held-outs were RED, restoring the old helper name made all four controls GREEN and preserves compatibility. Focused changed-surface suite is 62/62 green plus 4 seam controls; lint, typecheck, complexity, workflow lint, module-size (798/800), and diff checks pass. Renewed signed plan-review is PASS. Per operator instruction to push now and rely on CI, the 11,606-test make-test run was stopped green at 11%; Gerrit Verified remains the exhaustive gate and the ticket will not close before Verified +1.
